object: independent validation of B3M nonlinear step-rate predictor
question: Does the fixed D431 ExtraTrees model generalize to fresh exact-counter samples?
number: Twenty fresh WSL exact-counter samples with G=18f0e098 and seed D432-independent gave control [1.0,1.0], held-out r=0.6796754103, top-quarter ratio=1.2092425728, and permutation p=0.008 when scored by the fixed D431 model. This is finite LOCAL_ONLY validation; safe gain remains 0 because n=20, selector cost, larger-campaign stability, and rate-to-success linkage are unproved.
